description: This Java source file defines a custom data type 'DateDatatype' for handling date values (without time) within the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods for serializing and deserializing Date objects, as well as generating text summaries, and is marked as a Spring component.

classes.name: DateDatatype
classes.description: A custom data type class for handling date values (without time), extending SerializingCustomDatatype<Date>.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Returns a text summary of the date value formatted according to the user's date format.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a serialized string into a Date object, parsing with the specified date format. Throws InvalidCustomValueException on failure.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Date object into its string representation using the specified date format.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of the Date object, formatted as a string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Date object, handling invalid formats.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Date object into a string of format 'yyyy-MM-dd'.
